activity.notes: Ramón Freire served as Supreme Director of Chile from 4 April 1823 to 9 July 1826. This Activity is distinct from his later presidency because the constitutional office itself changed.

sources.title: Reseña Biográfica Ramón Freire Serrano — Biblioteca del Congreso Nacional de Chile
sources.citation_text: The Chilean Library of Congress records Ramón Freire as Supreme Director from 4 April 1823 to 9 July 1826.
